hook.text: Character.AI promised users their data would not be sold. On December 1, their chats go to auction. Also this week: New York bans AI chatbot toys. And an Indian AI that types what you say, in Telugu.
hook.tts: Character dot A I promised users their data would not be sold. On December first, their chats go to auction. Also this week: New York bans A I chatbot toys. And an Indian A I that types what you say, in Telugu.
hook.tts_te: క్యారెక్టర్ అనే చాట్‌బాట్ కంపెనీ ప్రామిస్: మీ డేటా సేఫ్. డిసెంబర్ ఫస్ట్ న, అవే చాట్స్ వేలానికి. ఇంకా: న్యూయార్క్ లో, చాట్‌బాట్ బొమ్మల మీద బ్యాన్. మనం మాట్లాడే తెలుగుని టైప్ చేసే, ఒక ఇండియన్ యాప్.

headline: Private AI chats
up for auction
stories.dek: Minnesota & California attorneys general · Nov 23-24 · TechCrunch
stories.chapter: Character.AI's users' chats go to auction
stories.text: Character.AI is bankrupt, and its December 1 sale includes users' chats and IP addresses: 21 million US accounts, 2.1 million of them kids. 42 US attorneys general asked the court to stop it, or at least keep kids' chats out. What you type into an AI app is company data, and it can be sold.
tts: Character dot A I is bankrupt, and its December first sale includes users' chats and I P addresses: twenty-one million U S accounts, two point one million of them children.
Forty-two U S attorneys general asked the court to stop it, or at least, to keep kids' chats out.
What you type into an A I app is company data, and it can be sold.
tts_te: దివాలా తీసిన క్యారెక్టర్ కంపెనీ, డిసెంబర్ ఫస్ట్ న అమ్మే వాటిలో, యూజర్ల చాట్స్ కూడా ఉన్నాయి: అమెరికాలో రెండు కోట్ల పది లక్షల అకౌంట్లు; వాటిలో ఇరవై ఒక్క లక్షలు పిల్లలవి.
నలభై రెండు అమెరికా రాష్ట్రాలు, ఈ అమ్మకం ఆపమని కోర్టుకి వెళ్ళాయి; కనీసం పిల్లల చాట్స్ వదిలేయమని.
చాట్‌బాట్ యాప్ లో మీరు టైప్ చేసేది, కంపెనీ డేటా; అది అమ్ముడు కూడా పోవచ్చు.
points: Character.AI, in Chapter 11 bankruptcy (filed in October, TechCrunch), is set to auction its assets on Dec 1, 2026: all chats with users' personal data, IP addresses and other metadata (Minnesota and California attorneys general)

Its privacy policy says "we do not sell personal information for monetary consideration"; more than 21 million US accounts, more than 2.1 million registered to minors; 42 attorneys general ask the court to deny the sale terms and the opening bidder's $350,000 break-up fee, and at a minimum to leave out kids' chats

headline: AI chatbot toys:
banned for 5 years
stories.dek: New York governor's office · Mon, Nov 24
stories.chapter: New York bans AI chatbot toys for five years
stories.text: New York has banned toys with built-in AI chatbots, like talking teddies, dolls and robots, for five years, with fines up to 15,000 dollars a day. It starts in about three months. Before you buy a talking toy, check if it goes online and what it records.
tts: New York has banned toys with built-in A I chatbots, like talking teddies, dolls and robots, for five years, with fines up to fifteen thousand dollars a day.
It starts in about three months.
Before you buy a talking toy, check if it goes online, and what it records.
tts_te: న్యూయార్క్, చాట్‌బాట్ ఉన్న బొమ్మల్ని, అంటే మాట్లాడే టెడ్డీలు, బొమ్మలు, రోబోలు, ఐదేళ్ల పాటు బ్యాన్ చేసింది; రోజుకి పన్నెండు లక్షల రూపాయలకి పైగా ఫైన్.
మాట్లాడే బొమ్మ కొనే ముందు, అది ఇంటర్నెట్ కి కనెక్ట్ అవుతుందా, ఏం రికార్డ్ చేస్తుందో, చూసుకోండి.
points: Governor Hochul signed (Nov 24) a five-year moratorium on making, distributing and selling toys with embedded or integrated AI chatbots, "such as talking stuffed animals, dolls and robots"; civil penalties up to $15,000 per day per violation, enforced by the Attorney General
It takes effect 90 days after signing, so not this holiday season; the release cites a watchdog's tests of AI toys marketed to children aged 3-12

headline: Grok sued over
sexual deepfakes
stories.dek: Oregon's Justice Department · Nov 22-23 · CNBC · claims, not a ruling
stories.chapter: Oregon and Virginia sue over Grok's sexual deepfakes
stories.text: Oregon and Virginia sued SpaceX, which now owns xAI and X, saying Grok made sexual fake images of real people, children included, while it was sold as safe. A watchdog study they cite counted about 3 million such images in 11 days, about 23,000 that appeared to show children. These are claims, not a ruling.
tts: Oregon and Virginia sued SpaceX, which now owns x A I and X, saying Grok made sexual fake images of real people, children included, while it was sold as safe.
A watchdog study they cite counted about three million such images in eleven days, about twenty-three thousand that appeared to show children.
These are claims, not a ruling.
tts_te: అమెరికా లోని ఒరెగాన్, వర్జీనియా రాష్ట్రాలు, గ్రోక్ చాట్‌బాట్ యజమాని స్పేస్‌ఎక్స్ మీద కేసులు వేశాయి: పిల్లలతో సహా, నిజమైన మనుషుల అసభ్య ఫేక్ ఫోటోలు గ్రోక్ తయారు చేసిందని.
వాళ్ళు చూపిన ఒక స్టడీ ప్రకారం, పదకొండు రోజుల్లో దాదాపు ముప్పై లక్షల ఫోటోలు; వాటిలో దాదాపు ఇరవై మూడు వేలు పిల్లలవిగా కనిపించాయి.
points: Oregon's attorney general (filed Nov 22, announced Nov 23) and Virginia's sued SpaceX, which owns xAI, Grok and X: they say Grok was marketed as safe while a "spicy" mode made nude and sexualised images, including of children; they seek injunctions, civil penalties and profits

Figures from a Center for Countering Digital Hate study (Dec 29, 2025 - Jan 8, 2026) cited by Oregon: about 3 million sexualised images posted on X, about 23,000 that appeared to depict children; claims in a lawsuit, not findings

headline: SAP weighs
10,000 job cuts
stories.dek: Bloomberg · CNBC · Nov 26-27 · not confirmed by SAP
stories.chapter: SAP weighs at least 10,000 job cuts in an AI restructuring
stories.text: The German software maker SAP is weighing at least 10,000 job cuts as it reorganises around AI, Bloomberg reports. SAP says no decisions have been made.
tts: The German software maker S A P is weighing at least ten thousand job cuts as it reorganises around A I, Bloomberg reports.
S A P says no decisions have been made.
tts_te: జర్మనీ సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్ కంపెనీ ఎస్ ఏ పీ, ఆర్టిఫిషియల్ ఇంటెలిజెన్స్ చుట్టూ మార్పుల్లో, కనీసం పది వేల ఉద్యోగాలు తగ్గించాలని ఆలోచిస్తోంది, అని బ్లూమ్‌బర్గ్ రిపోర్ట్.
ఎస్ ఏ పీ మాత్రం, ఇవి ఇంకా ఆలోచనలే అంటోంది.
points: Bloomberg (Nov 26) and CNBC (Nov 27): SAP is weighing cutting at least 10,000 positions (of more than 110,000) in an AI-focused restructuring; every department was asked to find cuts
SAP: "no decisions have been made regarding any further measures"; its 2024 restructuring also covered about 10,000 roles

headline: Speak Telugu,
get typed text
stories.dek: Sarvam's blog · Mon, Nov 23 · price and test by Sarvam
stories.chapter: Sarvam Dictate: voice typing in 22 Indian languages
stories.text: Finally: Bengaluru's Sarvam launched Dictate. Speak English or one of 22 Indian languages, Telugu too, and it types it out. For app makers, it costs 50 paise a minute. Sarvam says it needs fewer fixes than Gemini, in its own test.
tts: Finally: Bengaluru's Sarvam launched Dictate: speak English, or one of twenty-two Indian languages, Telugu too, and it types it out.
For app makers, it costs fifty paise a minute.
Sarvam says it needs fewer fixes than Gemini, in its own test.
tts_te: చివరగా: బెంగళూరు కంపెనీ సర్వం, డిక్టేట్ తెచ్చింది: ఇంగ్లీష్ లో గానీ, తెలుగుతో సహా ఇరవై రెండు భారతీయ భాషల్లో గానీ మాట్లాడితే, టైప్ చేసి ఇస్తుంది.
యాప్స్ తయారు చేసేవాళ్ళకి, నిమిషానికి యాభై పైసలు.
జెమిని కంటే తక్కువ తప్పులు, అని సర్వం తన సొంత టెస్ట్ లో చెప్తోంది.
points: Sarvam Dictate (Nov 23): an API for developers building dictation into their apps, English and 22 Indian languages (Telugu in its language menu), ₹0.50 per minute of audio; try it in the playground at indus.sarvam.ai/api-playground/dictation
Sarvam's own test on dictations from its Kivi app: in Indian languages 8.8% of characters needed editing vs 15.5% for Gemini 3.5 Transcribe; in English 4.2% vs 7.0%

ప్రతి శనివారం వీక్లీ న్యూస్ కోసం, ఈ ఛానెల్ ని సబ్‌స్క్రైబ్ చేసుకోండి.
